english.note: Use this specifically for traditional Chinese characters or the traditional Chinese writing system, contrasted with simplified Chinese.

examples.english: I’m used to traditional Chinese characters, so simplified ones actually feel strange to me.
examples.traditional: 我睇慣咗繁體字，轉做簡體反而唔習慣。
